sections.title: N+1 query patterns
sections.content:
**`src/routes/api/public/hooks/ci-poll-tick.ts:190-195`** — loops over up to 15 changesets, doing one `agents` lookup per row:
```ts
for (const cs of rows) {
  const { data: agent } = await supabaseAdmin.from("agents").select("id")
    .eq("user_id", cs.user_id).eq("slug", "builder").maybeSingle();
```
Fix: dedupe `user_id`s, run one `.in("user_id", ids)`, build a lookup map before the loop. 15 queries → 1.

**`src/lib/ai/tools/registry.server.ts`** — three separate spots do per-row writes in a loop instead of a batched call:
- `:1562-1577` (`studio.commit`) — individual `insert()` per staged path → batch `insert(rows)`.
- `:1476-1480` (`studio.stage`) — individual `upsert()` per change → batch `upsert(rows, { onConflict: "changeset_id,path" })`.
- `:2410-2421` (`backlog.prioritize`) — individual `update()` per opportunity (up to 30) → one `upsert(scores.map(...))`.

rawOutputPreview:
Both audits are grounded in the actual current source (not the stale test-file context), with file:line references. Here's the synthesized report.

## N+1 query patterns

**`src/routes/api/public/hooks/ci-poll-tick.ts:190-195`** — loops over up to 15 changesets, doing one `agents` lookup per row:
```ts
for (const cs of rows) {
  const { data: agent } = await supabaseAdmin.from("agents").select("id")
    .eq("user_id", cs.user_id).eq("slug", "builder").maybeSingle();
```
Fix: dedupe `user_id`s, run one `.in("user_id", ids)`, build a lookup map before the loop. 15 queries → 1.

**`src/lib/ai/tools/registry.server.ts`** — three separate spots do per-row writes in a loop instead of a batched call:
- `:1562-1577` (`studio.commit`) — individual `insert()` per staged path → batch `insert(rows)`.
- `:1476-1480` (`studio.stage`) — individual `upsert()` per change → batch `upsert(rows, { onConflict: "changeset_id,path" })`.
- `:2410-2421` (`backlog.prioritize`) — individual `update()` per opportunity (up to 30) → one `upsert(scores.map(...))`.

## Unnecessary re-renders (React)

**`src/components/discover/OpportunityQueue.tsx:214-216`** — `rankOpportunities()` (O(n log n) sort + string building) runs unmemoized on every render, including on every busy-flag toggle from 4 different mutations:
```tsx
// Before
const ranked = rankOpportunities(rows, (o) => ...);
// After
const ranked = useMemo(() => rankOpportunities(rows, (o) => ...), [rows, themeById]);
```
The file already memoizes `themeById` and two other derived values — this is the one that fell through.

**`OpportunityRow.tsx`** — not wrapped in `React.memo`; `OpportunityQueue.tsx:256-283` passes it fresh inline arrow functions for every callback on every render, so memoizing the row alone won't help without also `useCallback`-stabilizing the handlers.

**`src/hooks/use-machine-view.tsx:36-39`** and **`use-flow-mode.tsx:228-242`** — both context providers build an unmemoized value object and an inline closure each render,
